고정.identity_lock_en: Use the provided ORAKI MASTER reference images as the exact character identity reference. Do not redesign the character. Preserve exactly: the dumpling-shaped face and body, the eye shape and size, the mouth shape, the body proportions, the facial proportions, and the full detective outfit — hat, coat, ribbon, buttons and shoes. Only the expression, pose, action, camera angle, background and props may change.
고정._색상_미기재: 대표 색상(모자·코트·리본·단추·신발 각각의 색)은 마스터 이미지를 봐야 정확합니다. 확인하신 뒤 아래 칸을 채우고 identity_lock_en 문장에도 넣어 주세요.

_왜필요한가: 마스터 이미지들은 캐릭터가 화면 위 16%에서 아래 100%까지 꽉 찹니다. 발이 화면 바닥에 닿아 있습니다.
그대로 만들면 자막 대역(55~75%)에 캐릭터 픽셀의 35~42%가 걸려 자막이 옷 위에 얹힙니다.
그리고 릴스·쇼츠 앱 UI가 하단 약 20%를 가려 신발이 안 보입니다.
구도.composition_prompt_en: Vertical 9:16 framing. Place the character between 12% and 78% of the frame height, with the feet clearly above the bottom edge — never touching it. Keep the bottom 35% of the frame as background only, free of the character and of any text, reserved for subtitles. Do not crop the character at the frame edge.

negative_prompt_en: different character, different face, human face, different clothes, different hat, different body proportions, extra arms, extra legs, extra fingers, duplicate character, distorted hands, deformed face, closed eyes, obscured mouth, real shop signage, korean store signboard text, brand logos, trademarked logos, real people, photographs of real persons, watermark, text artifacts, subtitles baked into the image
